publicSafety.included: Status URLs, dates, source authorship, record types, tab provenance, public link metadata, handles, hashtags, dated visible interaction counts, classification evidence, and SHA-256 input digests.
publicSafety.excluded: Raw post text, profile biography text, historical contact details, cookies, session data, direct messages, private activity, local archive paths, and the identities, dates, URLs, and metrics of non-mission personal or network-context incoming records.
publicSafety.rawCaptureLocation: protected pointer outside the public repository

populationReconciliation.conclusion: Every one of the 434 records reported by the @urbanhermit profile counter materialized and was reviewed. Posts yielded 421 primary records. Replies rendered 436 article cards: 434 primary profile-counted records plus two conversation-parent cards authored by another account. Excluding those two contexts produces a 434-record union that reconciles exactly to the profile counter.
populationReconciliation.boundary: This is a complete review of the live profile-counted population visible in the authenticated interface on July 15, 2026. It does not establish that no older post was deleted, withheld, or otherwise absent from the live profile before capture.

publishingPattern.classificationMethod: The checked-in rule manifest was applied to source-post bodies, hashtags, and displayed link destinations. Quoted-card text was excluded. For native reposts, a positive signal describes the external source record that Jamie redistributed, not Jamie's authorship of its words.

postedUrlInventory.boundary: A posted URL documents publication or redistribution. It does not by itself establish authorship, endorsement, readership, participation, or impact. Displayed destinations reflect the authenticated interface and may be truncated historical labels.

findings: Creative-technology peers and collaborators publicly attributed WOW List development, the Horse Lords video, and analog-video community work to Jamie.
NYC Artist Coalition and a civic-design peer publicly connected Jamie to Cabaret Law repeal, cultural-space advocacy, and the Save NYC Spaces town hall.
KC Town Hall and a neighborhood collaborator publicly connected Jamie to recurring free tire-disposal work.
A KCUR-linked collaborator post and a separate published article connect Jamie to public-history interpretation of Kansas City's 8th Street Tunnel.
stakeholderInventory.boundary: This is a bounded year-by-year public-index search, not a complete historical engagement archive. It excludes likes, private activity, deleted or unindexed records, direct messages, and engagement that does not mention the handle. Two conversation-context records are retained without converting them into mission-relevant traction. The identities, dates, URLs, and metrics of nine non-mission personal or network-context records are withheld from the public fixture as unnecessary exposure.

visibleEngagementSnapshot.boundary: Dated interface counts are volatile. They are not unique people, reach, endorsement, conversion, attendance, or impact. Counts on external-source native repost records are excluded from account-authored totals.

missionSignalClassification.boundary: Positive labels are auditable from redacted matched evidence. A full false-negative replay requires the protected private capture because raw post text is intentionally excluded from the public repository.
